verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it keeps the "same memory and context" across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email, and that it runs on a persistent per-user machine with its own storage. Together these imply that context carries over into new conversations. However, there is no explicit documentation of recalling prior chats and applying them in new ones. Missing for 10: explicit docs on cross-conversation memory recall, detail on what is remembered and how it is applied, user controls to view or edit memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
